children.title: #27 upload pictures and videos – Content Creator Page
children.description:
If you upload a picture, you can do this from the gallery or through the camera function, then you have to add a description and then enter the price for paid media.​
For free posts, simply leave out the price.​

Another function is that you can click only for subscribers this post is then only displayed uncensored if you have a subscription.​

An important function is "schedule" where you can prepare posts that will automatically go online at the selected time.​

An Instagram function is also added here - you can fix up to 3 posts on the profile so that they are always displayed first All posts are then displayed normally consecutively under these fixed posts. Images and videos can also be pinned.​

Definition of Done​

Creators can upload media​

Creators can pin media​

Creators can schedule posting​

Creators can manage schedule​

List of scheduled posts should be available​

Uploaded media (including future ones) should have price set.​

Price can be changed any time​

*Upload finished content. No editing in the Web App​

For follow up​

Deletion of previously upload and/or paid content – can delete​

Downloadability of content (including save as workaround) – disabled, pause when tab is not active

children.title: #28 Status of User - Symbol
children.description:
On the profile of the respective user, a symbol is positioned behind the user's name which provides certain information about the user​
-Verified​

-Verified and already spent money (paying customer)​

-Subscriber​

The subscriber sign is only visible to the person who has subscribed.​

Users without a sign after their name have not yet verified themselves.​

They can view everything and support Kreator with comments and links as well as write messages, but cannot use any paid functions.​

On the profile you can click on the name to store information from the chat there​

(artist name, dates, other information) to collect information about your "fan" so that you don't have to search through the whole chat. This makes it easier to remember conversations.​

Definition of Done​

Symbols for – Verified, Customer (spent money on some content), Subscriber (all content available)​

Subscription at least 3 months​

Subscription will show everything in previous​

User story for Chat = Chat options should include Notes and Pinned messages
